title: The community app catalog grew in several directions
summary:
A community-heavy day: dozens of app listings, a fallback route for Claude, and clearer rules for submitting apps.

Thirty-four PRs added app listings spanning image and video creation, chat, classroom tools, games, bots, and developer tools. Examples include Vibed’s AI-assisted coding workspace, Orchive’s orchard advice, Hibiscus’s image and video studio, and FragBin’s shareable snippets. A separate PR refreshed the README’s ten-app showcase. Most catalog entries came through the app-adding agent, with further additions from the team.

Requests to `claude` and `claude-large` now route through AWS Bedrock first, with automatic fallback to Google Vertex AI if Bedrock fails. The change gives both Claude models another provider path without changing their model IDs.

App submission validation now requires Seed tier or higher, distinguishes unregistered or unset-tier accounts from rejected Spore submissions, and handles names containing spaces, quotes, or @ in duplicate checks. The submission form and review categories were revised, while the Hello and Enter tier explanations now spell out the Seed-to-Flower path and note that tier values may change during beta.
